definition: This dimension controls how skills decrease in effectiveness over time or with disuse, creating a dynamic where players must consistently engage with their skills to maintain proficiency. Variations can include gradual decay, sudden drops, or conditional decay based on external factors.
exclusion_criteria: Skills that only improve and never decrease
Static skill levels that do not reflect player engagement
inclusion_criteria: Skills decrease in effectiveness when not used for a certain period
The rate of decay can be influenced by character actions or game events
title: Skill Decay Mechanics
